NewsArticle.Title: Home Village Vote
NewsArticle.Content:
Mundanes of Abel, Rucesion, and Undine are willing to accept the expected Aisling population increase this in-game 6th year of Deoch.
Click on Riona in Mileth's inn to vote for the next village that will become the home of Aislings. Voting closes 99.08.25.
The next village will include the features found in the current home village of Aislings: Boards, Village Hall, Justice Hall, political offices, and hairstylist. As with the current homes of Aislings, regional tailoring will only be possible by a citizen of that village, if the village offer regional tailoring. Mundane preparation of the politics and boards of the next town is projected to be completed by the end of Year 6 of Deoch (in early September, Earth time).
For the first real-life week, anyone who renounces their current citizenship may become citizen of the selected village. After that, a Respected Citizen of the village is required to admit the new citizen. You need not renounce now. Wait until the next home village will accept you. As warned in-game, when renouncing citizenship you loose all current political power and recognition.
With continued population growth of about 500 simultaneous players online, another village will become home to Aislings. You're in your world now.
